# Archive fixtures

`deflated-utf8.zip` is synthetic test data generated with Python standard-library
`zipfile`, independently of the Rust ZIP implementation. It contains
`RJ123456/音声/説明.txt`, Deflate-compressed UTF-8 text consisting of
`日本語のファイル名とDeflate圧縮。\n` repeated 32 times. Its timestamp is fixed at
2026-01-01 00:00:00. No downloaded/user content is included.
